name: Mac Agent 执行通道
description:
## 用途

Mac Agent 主动连接 Relay 的本地执行通道。正常调试应启动真实 `mac-agent serve`；Apifox 主要用于观察协议，只有测试 Relay 路由时才手动模拟 Agent。

## Agent 可接收

- `project.list`
- `thread.list`
- `turn.start`
- `turn.interrupt`

## Agent 可发送

- `agent.hello`、`agent.status`
- `project.snapshot`、`thread.snapshot`
- `turn.started`、`turn.output`、`turn.snapshot`
- `turn.completed`、`turn.failed`、`turn.interrupted`、`turn.rejected`

## agent.hello 示例

```json
{
  "spec_version": "2.0",
  "message_id": "77777777777747778777777777777777",
  "type": "agent.hello",
  "occurred_at": "2026-08-10T02:20:00Z",
  "trace_id": "88888888888848888888888888888888",
  "sender": { "kind": "device", "id": "apifox-agent" },
  "payload": {
    "name": "Apifox Agent",
    "version": "test",
    "status": "idle"
  }
}
```

同角色只保留一个连接；用 Apifox 连接该端点会替换当前真实 Mac Agent。协议只接受 `2.0`。
